title: Adjunct equation for the transported canonical mate
statement: The transported intrinsic mate has the prescribed proper/open adjunct in every component.

source.place: Core gamma, adjunct, and canonical transport package

proof.text: Use mate whiskering and adjoint-conjugacy to transport the mate across the four canonical bridge isomorphisms. CanonicalBridge.push is by definition conjugate to CanonicalBridge.pull. The intrinsic gamma is definitionally the mate of alpha. Naturality and inverse/hom cancellation identify the transported mate component with transportedGamma.
Rewrite by that component equality and apply transportedGamma_adjunct, which gives the prescribed properOpenLambda inverse.

proof_origin.place: Canonical bridge transport via adjoint conjugacy; existing transportedGamma adjunct normalization

from.place: Core gamma, adjunct, and canonical transport package

lean.statement: theorem properOpenTransportMate_adjunct (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o) (a : OpenComparisons l E o c) (b : CanonicalBridge l E o) {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W) (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : System l E U) : (o.extension i).adj.homEquiv _ _ ((properOpenTransportMate l E o b k r p i h).app M) = (properOpenLambda l E o c a k r p i h).inv.app M
